capabilities_done: Crossover (src/multiband.rs): Linkwitz-Riley 4th-order splits (two Butterworth Q=1/sqrt2 cookbook sections per side), 1..3 strictly ascending crossovers in 20..rate/2; lower bands pass the allpasses of all higher crossovers so the band sum is AP_0..AP_{n-2}: |sum| = 1 within 1e-9 at 64 log-spaced frequencies for 2/3/4 bands at 44.1/48/96 kHz; per-band DFT magnitude equals band_magnitude() analytic within 1e-9; -6.02 dB at fc

MultibandCompressor: 2..4 bands, each band its own Dynamics gain computer (reused via pub(crate) detect/step); output = sum of gained bands; with all bands below threshold the output is bit-equal to the f64 crossover sum rounded to f32; latency 0; partition invariant; allocation only at construction

bind_spec_row / SPEC_ROWS / SpecRowError (src/spec_rows.rs): STU-FX-134a contract rows bound only where the spec gives meaning; rows without declared meaning are SpecRowError::Undeclared (typed refusal with reason), uncovered rows UnknownRow; Dynamics sheet covered (low/high_frequency, envelope_*, use_splines, use_noise_gate, makeup_gain (no unit), input/output_gain (no field), UNUSED slots refused)

Flanger/Chorus/Phaser (src/modulation.rs): f64 phase-accumulator LFO with stereo phase offset; Lagrange-3 fractional delay (read before write, 1-sample floor reported by delay_samples(); out(n) = x(n - d) within 1e-4 for a 1 kHz sine at 48/44.1/96 kHz); Flanger raised-cosine sweep initial->final (spec 0..20) with feedback comb (H = (1-mix) + mix z^-D/(1-g z^-D) matched within 1e-5); Chorus 1..4 voices (matched to the analytic time-varying fractional delay within 1e-5); Phaser 2..12 first-order allpasses, exponential sweep, feedback (Y = A^S X/(1 - g z^-1 A^S) matched within 1e-5; 2 stages at f_b notch); all partition invariant and reset-exact
spec_rows: Flanger initial/final/phase/mix/feedback bound; Flanger cycles/beats, Chorus/Flanger width/intensity/transience, Phaser intensity/depth refused as Undeclared; Phaser mix bound

ClickRepair (src/restore.rs): fixed analysis windows 2048 / hop 1536 repairing only their centre (latency 1792, partition invariant), Levinson-Durbin AR(p) fit, segment-local robust residual scale, flags merged within p, then twice a covariance-method AR refit over rows touching no detected sample plus re-detection on the clean-row scale, least-squares AR interpolation (Toeplitz normal equations, Cholesky); gaps > max_gap_ms (<= 128 samples) skipped and counted; untouched samples bit-exact. Measured: clean material bit-exact with 0 detections; 30 clicks (1..12 samples) all repaired, SNR improvement 28.62 dB, worst repaired-sample error 0.0302; 80-sample burst repaired at 2.5 ms with gap error RMS 0.0084 (signal RMS 0.263)

HumRemover: cookbook notch cascade at k*f0 (k <= 16, below 0.95 Nyquist), bandwidth_hz per notch, f64; 5 hum harmonics < 1e-5 residual amplitude in steady state; 440 Hz passes with the analytic cascade magnitude (1e-5)
